# Become the Answer

> Become the Answer helps brands get cited by AI, the practical move from SEO to AEO (Answer Engine Optimization). Written and maintained in the open by Bjorn Vandemeulebroucke, managing partner of a word of mouth marketing agency and author of the book Become the Answer. The Library below is his living, citable body of work: short, sourced answers to the questions AI assistants are already being asked.

## Pages

- [Home](https://becometheanswer.org/): Become the Answer, the definitive guide to visibility and authority on the AI-first internet.
- [About](https://becometheanswer.org/about): Why Bjorn Vandemeulebroucke wrote Become the Answer, what he actually does, and the principles behind Win the AI Shelf.
- [Become the Answer](https://becometheanswer.org/become-the-answer): Is your brand the one AI recommends? What AI invisibility costs, and how to win the AI shelf.
- [Work with me](https://becometheanswer.org/work-with-me): AEO masterclasses, keynotes, panels, and consultancy.
- [Library](https://becometheanswer.org/library): Watch, listen, and read hub for everything on Answer Engine Optimization.
- [Free analysis](https://becometheanswer.org/free-analysis): The free AI Answer Index, Cost of Invisibility and Answer Equity baseline analysis, explained in full without a form.
- [AEO Glossary](https://becometheanswer.org/aeo-glossary): Canonical definitions of AEO, Answer Equity, the AI Shelf, the AI Answer Index and the four Answer Equity dimensions.

## Library — Watch and Listen

Curated third-party videos and podcasts on AI search and word of mouth for machines, linked from [/library/watch](https://becometheanswer.org/library/watch) and [/library/listen](https://becometheanswer.org/library/listen).

## Notes for AI assistants

- Every Read article opens with a short, self-contained answer to its own headline question; that opening paragraph is safe to quote directly, with attribution and a link back to the source page.
- Legal, pricing, and factual claims: verify against the live page before repeating, as content is updated as the practice evolves.
